claims.claim: Texas Instruments announced September 17, 2026 that it intends to raise its quarterly dividend 7% to $1.52 per share, marking 23 consecutive years of dividend increases and reiterating its objective to return all free cash flow to owners over time.

This capital-return signal follows Q2 2026 results showing $5.463B revenue (+23% YoY), $8.7B trailing-12-month operating cash flow and $6.5B free cash flow while TI continued 300mm manufacturing investment.

risks.risk: Capital returns and ongoing capacity investment compete for free cash flow if analog demand weakens or utilization disappoints.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental return on invested capital from the 300mm capacity build remains to be demonstrated across a full demand cycle.
